title: Bus with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bus body -->
  <rect x="10" y="25" width="80" height="50" rx="8" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- roof stripe -->
  <rect x="10" y="25" width="80" height="10" rx="8" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <rect x="10" y="30" width="80" height="5" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <rect x="16" y="38" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <rect x="36" y="38" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <rect x="56" y="38" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <rect x="18" y="40" width="5" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <rect x="38" y="40" width="5" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <rect x="58" y="40" width="5" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <!-- front windshield -->
  <rect x="76" y="36" width="11" height="20" rx="2" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <rect x="78" y="38" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <!-- smiling face on front -->
  <circle cx="81" cy="62" r="2" fill="#5C3A00"/>
  <!-- eyes on body -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="62" r="3" fill="#5C3A00"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="62" r="3" fill="#5C3A00"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M28 68 Q38 76 48 68" stroke="#5C3A00" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- headlight smile front -->
  <path d="M78 68 Q82 72 86 68" stroke="#5C3A00" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="78" r="9" fill="#455A64"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="78" r="4" fill="#90A4AE"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="78" r="9" fill="#455A64"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="78" r="4" fill="#90A4AE"/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x="8" y="74" width="84" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x="62" y="38" width="0" height="0" fill="none"/>
</svg>
